summary: Wrote a six-phase implementation plan covering both authorized halves. Half B restructures external-process-wait.md Rule 1 into numbered, caller-agnostic requirements (so it binds the orchestrator's own foreground calls, not only dispatched subagents) and adds a generic exit-124 step. Half A appends one canonical fragment carrying the 600000 value plus a path cross-reference at every in-scope runtime redeploy-remedy site, held in a per-script variable rather than a shared common.sh helper. Nine recorded rulings answer all three ALSO RULE ON questions plus the orchestrator-caller question, and name the harness-initiated-backgrounding shape with its two distinct remedies.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan, 7h estimate, five dependency waves; every long-command step carries the bounded-wait idiom inline.
